templates.purpose: Training class enrollment confirmation for a course or workshop
Building maintenance water outage notice during scheduled plumbing repairs

records.draft: Hello Casey. We are happy to confirm your enrollment in the upcoming training course and workshop on Saturday 14:00. Your enrollment reference is C15. We look forward to welcoming you to the class.

Dear Jamie, please note that the building water supply will be interrupted Monday 08:00-10:00 while scheduled plumbing maintenance and repairs are carried out. Your maintenance notice reference is M26.
Hello Taylor. Your registration for the training course and learning workshop on Sunday 11:00 is confirmed. Please retain your class enrollment reference C37. Thank you for signing up for this class.

Dear Jordan, the building plumbing maintenance team will turn the water off Tuesday 12:00-14:00 for scheduled repair works. Please refer to maintenance notice M48. Thank you for your patience during this water outage.

Taylor: class confirmed Sunday 11:00. Enrollment C37.
Jordan: water off Tuesday 12:00-14:00 for repairs. Notice M48.
